item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 13/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. The easterly airstream is expected to be replaced by a southerly airstream gradually in the latter part of this week. The weather will be hot with a few showers over the coast of southern China. Upper-air disturbances will bring unsettled weather to southern China early next week.

Weather: Becoming cloudy. Dry with sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 23 - 30 C
R.H. range: 55 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
